spans.s:
भैम भैम, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. भीम), relating
to Bhīma; (आस्), m. pl. the descendants of Bhīma;
(ई), f. ‘the daughter of Bhīma,’ a patronymic of
Damayantī; a festival on the eleventh day of Māgha,
when ceremonies with तिल or sesamum are performed
in honour of Bhīma; [cf. Lith. baime†, ‘terror.’]
—भैम-प्रवीर, अस्, m. the bravest of the
Bhaimas, the chief of the Bhaimas.

भैमगव, अस्, m. (fr. भीम-गव), a patro-
nymic.

भैमरथ, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. भीम-रथ),
relating to Bhīma-ratha.

भैमसेन्य, अस्, m. (fr. भीम-सेन), a patro-
nymic.

भैमायन, अस्, m. a patronymic (see Scholiast
on Pāṇ.

भैमि, इस्, m. (fr. भीम), a patronymic of
Ghaṭotkaca.
